reference_format.note: YY/NNNNN/TYPE. Scottish type codes appear (PPP for planning permission in principle, EIASCR for EIA screening).

quirks.summary: Search-result metaInfo fields are separated by U+00B7, not '|'.
quirks.workaround: Split on U+00B7, or take the reference up to the first whitespace.

quirks.summary: The council's committee-papers system was not identified in this run.
quirks.detail: Two requests to the council website (a guessed committees page, 404, and the home page) found no link to a committee system. Committee reports may not be on the portal's documents tab.
quirks.workaround: For a committee decision, find the committee system from the council website before recording a report as missing.

pacing.note: Seven requests at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 with no 429 or challenge. NetScaler (NSC_) cookies set; passive.

robots.note: robots.txt is 'User-agent: *' with 'Disallow: /', so the whole host is disallowed to automated clients.

verification.note: Portal resolved from PlanIt's areas record and fingerprinted as Idox ('Powered by Idox', search.do, _csrf, keyVal). The results were planning references (FUL, PPP, EIASCR), so this is the planning register rather than building standards. Advanced search by received date 1-7 September 2026 -> 7 results -> 26/01136/FUL documents tab (18 file links) -> downloaded one file with the session and Referer: application/pdf, %PDF-1.7, 1,852,161 bytes, one page (a landscaping drawing) with extractable text, no rate-limit, permission or unavailable notice.
